units.source_text: 她好像几个月才盼来了这样的话伴，又饶有兴味地谈起不曾看过的电影和戏剧。

en.t: It was as though she had waited months for this kind of companion in conversation, and she began talking again with lively interest about films and plays she had never seen.

units.source_text: 一百九十九天以前，那时她也热衷过这类谈话，难道她忘记了自己曾情不自禁地投到岛村怀里的那股劲头了吗？

en.t: One hundred and ninety-nine days earlier, she too had been absorbed in this sort of talk; could she have forgotten the force with which she had once thrown herself, unable to help it, into Shimamura's arms?

units.source_text: 此时此刻她仿佛又因自己所描述的事物而连身体都变得热乎起来了。

en.t: At that very moment, it was as if even her body had grown warm again from the things she herself was describing.
